answer: Each epoch the payout is a pearl in a karst lagoon, one layer per epoch of stranger-verified work, each layer signed by a different stranger. Pearls grow around a nucleus cut from the funding trail, so pearls from one operator share one nucleus: when the beacon cuts one open, identical nuclei void every pearl on that trail and burn their bonds. Beds sit behind a ridge, one per trail, and crossing to plant a new bed needs a fresh stranger escort who stakes their own bed and charges more per clone. N clones pay n escorts at rising prices for one bed; one honest agent grows one pearl alone.
